source_acquisition.search_note: reports/tables/visual_source_inventory.csv records an automated no_public_source_found row and suggests aigc-apps/VideoX-Fun; corpus/visual_sources/iclr-2026-f448909bdd66/ is absent. The PDF reference on p.11 directly links VideoX-Fun as a generic Wan initialization/baseline source, not a MotionStream paper repository. gh metadata/tree, README, and the examined streaming prediction, distillation, model, and pipeline files confirm generic causal/self-forcing/chunk/rolling-KV code but no MotionStream-named assets, Figure/Table generator, plot script, TeX/TikZ/PGF, notebook, or paper asset index. The repository therefore exists without an exact visual source; all figure geometry/color claims are rendered estimates and table claims use PDF objects.

paper_style.palette_strategy: Quantitative curves use a categorical blue/orange/green/red/purple palette; attention maps use sequential blue with gray masks; qualitative frames retain natural colors and green/red/blue control overlays; tables are predominantly black and white with bold/underline. Marker, position, direct labels, and table typography provide partial redundancy, but the many natural colors and curve hues are not fully grayscale-safe.
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: The 26-page PDF was rendered at 200 dpi (1700×2200 px per page). pdfimages shows the main contents of Figures 1–8 and A1–A6 as embedded JPEG/PNG raster XObjects, while captions, table text, rules, and surrounding prose remain PDF text/line objects. Figure geometry and plot typography are therefore rendered estimates; table typography and rules are PDF-object evidence.
paper_style.style_consistency: The double-column letter layout uses stable Computer Modern/Nimbus Roman-like body, caption, and table typography with Arial/Matplotlib-like sans-serif labels inside raster plots. Booktabs/minimal tables consistently omit vertical rules; quantitative plots reuse axis/legend conventions, while qualitative/UI panels inherit natural-image and screenshot typography. Model names vary between Ours Teacher, Ours Causal, and Ours Distilled, so per-object legends remain necessary.

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Prior motion-controlled video diffusion models typically operate offline to generate fixed-length sequences in parallel (top left). In contrast, our MotionStream enables streaming long-video generation from a single image with track control at interactive speed (bottom left). MotionStream can be applied to a variety of online downstream applications, such as real-time motion transfer, user drag operations, and 3D camera control (right).

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Model architecture and training pipeline. To build a teacher motion-controlled video model, we extract and randomly sample 2D tracks from the input video and encode them using a lightweight track head. The resulting track embeddings are combined with the input image, noisy video latents, and text embeddings as input to the diffusion transformer with bidirectional attention, which is then trained with a flow matching loss (top). We then distill a few-step causal diffusion model from the teacher through Self Forcing-style DMD distillation, integrating joint text-motion guidance into the objective, where autoregressive rollout with rolling KV cache and attention sink is applied during both training and inference (bottom).

figures.label: Figure 6

caption.text: Figure 6: Impact of Sparse Attention Patterns. Using longer clips (up to 241 frames) from the Sora subset, we ablate attention sink size and local window size in extrapolation scenarios. Having at least a single sink chunk is crucial, but more provides marginal benefit, while larger window sizes degrade performance as attending to long-past history allows errors to accumulate in context tokens.

figures.label: Figure A6
figures.module: appendix F / limitations and failure cases

caption.text: Figure A6: Failure Cases. In the cat and turtle examples, the intention was to bring the cat out of the box and make the turtle hatch from the egg. However, due to limitations in hand-drawn trajectories for expressing complex motions and the backbone model’s generalization capacity, the outputs are not physically plausible, and objects are either deformed or simply translated along the tracks. In complex scenes with multiple human identities (second example), the model often loses identity information and produces artifacts. The last row shows our model’s output on the world exploration task. Since track representation struggles to capture complete scene transitions and the attention sink prioritizes preserving source features, our pipeline faces difficulty in scenarios where new objects appear or scenes continuously change. More videos can be found on our supplementary website.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 establishes the offline→streaming target; Figure 2 gives the teacher/track-head/student pipeline; Figure 3 supplies the initial-token attention-sink mechanism. Tables 1–2 provide motion-transfer and camera-control quality/speed headlines; Figures 4–5 isolate joint-guidance trade-offs; Table 3 isolates track representation; Figure 6 and Table 4 connect sparse-attention choices to long-horizon stability and cost. Figures 7–8 then show downstream applications and the interactive demo. Appendix Tables A1–A2 quantify Tiny VAE cost, Table A3/Figure A1 add multi-dimensional and human-preference checks, Figure A2/A3 expand operating-point and long-horizon evidence, and Table A4/Figures A4–A6 define conditioning, qualitative, and failure boundaries.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Captions use a consistent Figure/Table label and sentence-style prose. Figures 4–6, A1–A4, and A6 state a main finding, while Table 1/2 and Figure 8 are title-like and depend on body text. Most captions omit aggregation, sample selection, frame sampling, and uncertainty/± definitions; A1, A2, A5, and A6 are more explicit about denominators or control-color semantics. Captions repeatedly point to sections or supplementary videos when the static PDF cannot carry the full protocol.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Tables 1–2 use dataset/metric grouped headers; Table 3 uses paired DAVIS/Sora metrics; Table 4 uses a Sora Extended configuration group. Appendix A1/A2 pair decoder/runtime columns, A3 wraps VBench dimensions, and A4 combines VBench-style metrics with FVD. All use booktabs/minimal rules without vertical lines and black/white bold/underline highlighting, while metric directions and mixed precision must be read from headers or prose.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 2 and the track-head/guidance equations define the method interface; Tables 1–2 establish task quality/speed; Figures 4–5 and Table 3 test guidance and representation; Figure 6/Table 4 test sparse attention and system cost; A1/A2 test Tiny VAE; A3/Figure A1/A4 provide multi-dimensional, human, and qualitative checks; A6 returns to explicit failure modes. This gives a method→result→mechanism/efficiency→boundary chain rather than isolated plots.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: The main pages keep the headline workflow, benchmark, guidance, representation, and sparse-attention evidence. Appendix A supplies Tiny VAE reconstruction and end-to-end speed; Appendix B supplies VBench/user study; Appendix C supplies chunk/step, long-horizon, qualitative, and motion-conditioning checks; Appendix D adds streaming examples; Appendix F supplies failure cases. Supplementary videos are unavailable locally, so demo continuity remains outside the auditable PDF.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF caption/table text consistently uses Computer Modern/Nimbus Roman-like objects, with bold/italic variants for labels and headers. Raster plots use small sans-serif axes/legends and qualitative/UI frames bring their own text, creating a clear functional hierarchy but not one exact figure font. Wide appendix objects preserve the same table typography while increasing density.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Blue/orange/green/red/purple recur in quantitative guidance and attention-related plots; sequential blue is reserved for attention maps; green/red/blue control overlays recur in streaming UI examples; natural image colors are not model identities. Figure A1 uses blue/gray preference bars locally. Direct labels, marker/line choices, row/column positions, and booktabs highlights are necessary redundancy because cross-figure color identity is not globally fixed.

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 1/2 的 offline→streaming 概念图与 teacher→student pipeline，把系统目标、控制输入、cache 和应用出口放在一条流程中。
Figure 4/5 的 paired quantitative/qualitative guidance ablation，同时呈现 motion adherence 与 natural dynamics 的 trade-off。
Figure 6/Table 4 与 Figure A2/A3 的 configuration→time-course→operating-point 链，区分 sparse attention 的 quality mechanism 与 latency cost。
Table A1/A2 的 decoder-only 与 end-to-end paired comparison，避免把 Tiny VAE 的局部加速直接等同于完整系统速度。
Figure A6 的按失败机制分组 qualitative grid，把 complex tracks、identity、scene change 与 attention-sink boundary 写进 caption。
highest_value_objects: Figure 6/Table 4：long-video stability、attention configuration 与系统成本的关键消融。
Figure 4/5：guidance mechanism 最清晰的定量/定性组合。
Figure A2/A3、Table A1/A2 和 Figure A6：分别限定 operating point、VAE cost 与 failure boundary。
failure_patterns: 公开候选仓库只有通用 VideoX-Fun causal/self-forcing 代码，没有本文 Figure/Table 的可编辑 plotting、TeX 或 source asset；图形排版只能从 PDF 复核。
Table 1/2、Figure 7/8 的 caption 信息偏少；Table 4 的 c3s1w1、Figure A2 的 color/shape legend、Figure 4/6 的曲线 aggregation 和 ± variation 规则脱离正文不可完整复原。
Qualitative grids、user study 和 attention plots 普遍缺 sample selection、uncertainty 或 failure rate；Figure A6 有边界叙述但仍无 denominator，supplementary videos 也无法本地核验。
多 backbone、resolution、输入轨迹协议和 operating-point 选择使跨-baseline ranking 受条件影响，缺少覆盖全部 chunk/scene-transition 的 controlled ablation。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文以“offline/streaming workflow → teacher/student 与 attention mechanism → quality/speed benchmark → guidance、representation、sparse-attention 消融 → Tiny VAE、interactive demo 与 failure cases”的双栏证据链，把实时交互能力与长时稳定性、质量成本和适用边界串联起来，但图表源代码和 supplementary video 证据未公开。
